heroHeadline: GAO FINDS NASA LACKS SINGLE COST ESTIMATE FOR MOON-TO-MARS PROGRAM
heroSubtitle: Oct 3: The GAO found NASA has no single authoritative cost estimate for its Moon-to-Mars program, raising concerns about budget accountability ahead of future Congressional reviews. Sep 28: NASA assigned the Artemis II crew — Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen — to a new mission following their historic lunar flyby in April 2026, the first humans to orbit the Moon since Apollo 17 in 1972. Aug 14: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said he is "extremely confident" Artemis III will launch in 2027. Artemis Accords stand at 70 signatory nations.
footerNote: Data sourced from NASA.gov, OIG Reports, SpaceNews, Ars Technica, Congressional appropriations. Tier 1: NASA/ESA/Official. Tier 2: SpaceNews/Ars Technica/Reuters. Tier 3: Planetary Society/AIAA.
